newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stats office forecasts 1.0 pct 97 inflation.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stats office forecasts 1.0 pct 97 inflation.

text.p: Swiss inflation is likely to remain within an average 0.8 to 0.9 percent for 1996 as a whole and rise modestly to about 1.0 percent on average in 1997, the Swiss Federal Statistics office said.
"The economic conditions speak for continued moderate inflation in the coming year," the statistics office said in a statement.
Declining mortgage interest rates should have a moderating effect on inflation in 1997, the statistics office said.
In addition, it said no strong price pressures are to be expected from private consumption, where only a weak pickup is underway.
"The Federal Statistics Office estimates that under these conditions average annual inflation for 1997 will be about one percent," the statement added. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
